h1: The 6 Best Laptop Charging Carts of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Laptop Charging Carts 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six laptop charging carts from 16 to 42 devices, compared on capacity, screen size limits, locks and price bracket.
summary: The Meteteel 20-device cart is our best overall for most rooms. Tripp Lite leads at enterprise scale with 42 ports, Pearington and POCHAR cover 30-device needs, VEVOR fits 15.6 in laptops, and Hupsjer is the low-cost small cart.
intro: The slot size is the spec buyers forget. A cart that says 30 devices may only take screens up to 14 inches, and a thick rugged case can stop a laptop from fitting at all.
We ranked six carts from their listings on capacity, the largest screen each slot accepts, locking, power protection and how much assembly you face. Prices run from $100-200 up to $500+.

products.name: Meteteel Fully Assembled 20 Device Laptop Charging Cart for School (Black)
products.verdict: A ready-to-use 20-device cart with locks on both sides.
products.description:
The Meteteel is a 20-device cart that arrives 95% pre-assembled, needing only wheels, cord wrap and handle attached. It has independent front and back locks and a ventilated American-style steel frame, in the $200-500 bracket.

It takes first place because little assembly and two separate locks make it the easiest to deploy. Pearington holds more devices but needs full assembly, and Hupsjer holds fewer at a lower price.

It suits a classroom set of about 20. The caveat is that the listing gives no screen limit here, so check device size first.

products.name: Tripp Lite 42-Port AC Mobile Charging Cart Storage Station for Chromebooks, iPads
products.description:
The Tripp Lite offers 42 NEMA 5-15R outlets at 1,440W total, with timed charging zones and an in-cabinet RJ45 Ethernet jack. It has a 2-year warranty and tech support, in the $500+ bracket.

It ranks second because the price is the highest here, which only pays off at large scale. Next to the Meteteel, it holds twice the outlets and adds timed zones.

It suits IT departments deploying many devices. The caveat is the $500+ cost.
products.skipIf: You only need one classroom set.

products.name: Pearington 30 Device Mobile Charging/Storage Cart for iPads, Tablets, Laptop
products.verdict: 30 locked bays plus 2 bonus outlets, but full assembly.
products.description:
The Pearington has 30 bays plus 2 bonus outlets, so 32 devices charge while 30 store locked. Slots measure 11.4 in high by 1.5 in wide for screens up to 13 in, and full assembly is required, in the $200-500 bracket.

It ranks third because full assembly costs setup time the Meteteel avoids, and the 13 in cap is the lowest here. Capacity is its edge.

It suits a single classroom or department. The caveat is the 13 in screen limit.

products.name: POCHAR 30 Unit Device Charging Station for Chromebook, iPad, 14'' Laptop
products.verdict: One cart for Chromebooks, iPads and 14 in laptops.
products.description:
The POCHAR holds 30 devices up to 14 in and 1.5 in thick. It has numbered bays, removable front and rear doors, and four keys total, two per lock, in the $200-500 bracket.

It ranks fourth because it matches the Pearington on capacity while taking larger 14 in screens, but gives no extra outlets. The numbered bays help track devices.

It suits mixed-device fleets. The caveat is that 14 in is still not enough for bigger business laptops.
products.idealFor: Mixed Chromebook, iPad and laptop fleets.

products.name: VEVOR Laptop Cart, 20 Device Mobile Charging Cart, Up to 15.6" Screen Size
products.verdict: The only cart here that takes 15.6 in screens.
products.description:
The VEVOR holds 20 devices up to 15.6 in, with built-in surge protection and 2 of 4 casters lockable, in the $200-500 bracket.

It ranks fifth because half its casters lock and it offers 20 slots like the Meteteel. Its larger slot is the differentiator.

It suits fleets of bigger business laptops. The caveat is the partial caster locking.
products.skipIf: Your devices are 14 in or smaller.

products.name: Hupsjer 16-Device Mobile Charging Cart, Laptop Charging Station w/Storage Shelf
products.verdict: The lowest-priced cart, with a separate cable compartment.
products.description:
The Hupsjer holds 16 devices and adds a separate cable and adapter compartment measuring 25.2 by 15 by 3.5 in. It has adjustable removable dividers, a padded shelf, 2 of 4 casters lockable and a side handle, in the $100-200 bracket.

It ranks last because 16 slots is the smallest capacity here. It is the cheapest option, though.

It suits small classrooms on a tight budget. The caveat is the small capacity.
products.idealFor: Small classrooms on a tight budget.
